name: lede
label: Lede
default: None of it is a tooling problem you created. It is what happens when the standard was never written down.

default.line: A spreadsheet HR sent in January, a Notion page you gave up on by April, a Notes file, and still no answer to “how is she doing?”
Review season arrives and you spend a weekend assembling a story you should already have had.
You know who your strongest person is. You could not prove it.
Every manager on the floor does this differently, so none of it compares.
Your energy goes to the bottom of the team, and you call that managing.
